data.title: Analyst Raises Concerns Over Wireless Carrier Pricing and Retention Following SpaceX News
data.description: Analysts warn that a SpaceX-built phone using its own network could pressure carrier pricing and offer features that existing wireless providers lack.

data.title: American Express Has More Room to Run Despite Rising Competition, Analyst Says
data.description: Analysts back American Express (NYSE: AXP) on premium card growth. BMO initiates with $380 price target while RBC maintains Outperform.

data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Dogecoin Gain 2% Ahead of Weekend: 2 Scenarios to Watch

data.title: Transocean Gets $1 Billion Equinor Green Light, Adds $62 Million Shell Contract
data.description: Transocean secures $1.1 billion in firm contract backlog following Equinor's final approval and a new $62 million Shell drilling contract.

data.title: Shell, Chevron, BP Pull Crews as Hurricane Isaias Barrels Toward Gulf Coast Refineries
data.description: Shell, Chevron and BP evacuate Gulf platforms and cut production as Hurricane Isaias nears the Gulf Coast, raising refinery, fuel price and shipping risks.
